**Finding: missing** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere — searches for "insurance", "insur", "coverage" and "indemnif" all return zero hits, and Section 10 (General Provisions, p0059–p0070) runs straight from Notices to Headings/Counterparts.

That matters here because HDI is not a passive counterparty: it develops and hosts the Site, and Section 8.1 confirms it "may have access to or be exposed to... Content, user information, data, knowledge and proprietary and trade secret information of the Company." A hosting vendor processing our user data with no coverage at all sits in the playbook's walk-away band, so this is recorded as missing rather than a minor gap.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 10.9 inserted after p0070 at the preferred limits — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber liability USD 5M where HDI processes Company Confidential Information or user information, workers' compensation as required by law, plus certificates on request, maintained through the term and one year after. The cyber trigger is drafted to the document's own defined terms rather than an undefined "Customer Data."

The comment offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) up front, since limits are the likeliest point of pushback and the rule treats that level as acceptable.
